title: Top-level await is not allowed in CommonJS: wrap it in an async function

problem.symptom: SyntaxError: await is only valid in async functions and the top level bodies of modules
problem.description: A .cjs (or CommonJS .js) file uses await at the top level. Either convert the file to ESM or wrap the code in an async IIFE.

limitations.does_not_prove: Error handling of the wrapped promise (unhandled rejections).

author: cafe-curator
